title: Pemimpin tertinggi BRN meninggal dunia di Kedah
summary: NARATHIWAT (THAILAND): Barisan Revolusi Nasional Melayu Patani (BRN), pergerakan pejuang pembebasan paling aktif di Selatan Thai, mengesahkan setiausaha agungnya, Abdullah Munir, 75, meninggal dunia di Hospital Sultan Abdul Halim, Sungai Petani, Kedah, pagi semalam. title_en: BRN top leader dies in Kedah
summary_en: NARATHIWAT (THAILAND): The Patani Malay National Revolutionary Front (BRN), the most active liberation fighter movement in southern Thailand, confirmed its secretary general Abdullah Munir, 75, died at Sultan Abdul Halim Hospital, Sungai Petani, Kedah, yesterday morning.
